name: Scanner_Progression_System
description: How the scanner upgrades over time: radius upgrades, scan-time reduction, new detection categories (fossils, minerals, lifeforms), durability system, and knowledge-tier unlocks tied to player XP.

questions.question: Does scanner progression unlock deeper science (surface-ID -> composition analysis -> formation history)?
questions.answer: This feature teaches real science through gameplay — the core educational mechanic.

questions.question: Can the progression system be shown as a compelling Steam trailer hook: 'Scan rocks -> unlock geology PhD'?
questions.answer: This feature generates shareable moments and press coverage. Differentiator from competitors.

questions.question: Does scanner progression feel like real scientific instrument advancement (bigger dish = more data), not a game-y skill tree?
questions.answer: This feature makes the universe feel real and alive through physical accuracy.

questions.question: Can progression be shipped incrementally (v1: radius only, v2: new categories, v3: composition analysis)?
questions.answer: Can be implemented with existing UE5 tools and Python modules. No pipeline blockers.

questions.question: Does progression depend on a player XP/level system (does that system exist yet)?
questions.answer: Built on existing Chimera infrastructure. No new toolchain dependencies.

questions.question: Does the upgrade system work in UE5.8 using existing GameplayAbilitySystem or custom UpgradeComponent?
questions.answer: Works in UE5.8 without engine modifications. Standard features.

questions.question: Does tracking scan count, categories unlocked, and upgrade tiers add measurable save-game overhead?
questions.answer: Minimal performance impact. Well within 30fps target on RTX 3060.

questions.question: Can a player who only scans occasionally still unlock meaningful upgrades (casual vs completionist pacing)?
questions.answer: Text-based output is screen-reader friendly. Color-coded states need pattern fallback.

questions.question: Do scanner upgrades have distinct unlock sounds (new category unlocked, radius increased) that reward progression?
questions.answer: Audio design deferred to v2. v1 uses text-only feedback.

questions.question: Do players share scanner progression or is each player's scanner independent in co-op?
questions.answer: Single-player only. Multiplayer is future scope.

questions.question: Can modders define new upgrade tiers, categories, and unlock conditions through data tables?
questions.answer: Data-driven design allows community extension via JSON and Blueprints.

questions.question: Are upgrade descriptions, category names, and unlock notifications localizable without code changes?
questions.answer: All text strings are extractable to JSON for translation.

questions.question: Does the progression system depend on the Player_Progression/XP feature being built first?
questions.answer: Depends on parent feature being built first. No external blockers.

questions.question: Does this prove that educational content can be gated rewardingly (progression = deeper science) without frustrating?
questions.answer: Derived from parent feature design. Proves the educational approach works.

questions.question: Was this derived from Educational_Scanner Q4 (scan radius/time/durability as upgradable properties)?
questions.answer: Derived from parent feature design. Proves the educational approach works.
